Description

Description

Stay comfortable while showing your Boston pride with our classic Boston 1630 Nantucket Fleece Crewneck Sweatshirt. Featuring bold navy collegiate lettering outlined in white and a timeless "1630" design, this premium fleece crew offers a clean, traditional New England look that never goes out of style.

Made from soft, midweight Nantucket Fleece, this sweatshirt delivers exceptional comfort and warmth for cool mornings, evenings on the waterfront, fall adventures, and year-round casual wear. The relaxed unisex fit makes it perfect for layering and everyday comfort.

Whether you're strolling through Boston, visiting the waterfront, cheering on your favorite team, or looking for the perfect Boston souvenir, this classic crewneck is a wardrobe essential.

Features

  • Premium Nantucket Fleece crewneck sweatshirt
  • Classic Boston 1630 collegiate design
  • Navy lettering with white outline
  • Soft brushed fleece interior
  • Rib-knit collar, cuffs, and waistband
  • Comfortable unisex fit
  • Heather Grey color
  • Available in Adult Sizes Small through 2XL
  • Ideal for layering in all seasons
